name: Thanksgiving Traditional White Bread / Sourdough Stuffing (Dressing)
groceryIngredients: Cubed White Sourdough Bread (or Stove Top Stuffing Mix)
whyItWorks: Bread cubes soaked in savory turkey bone broth and baked until custard-soft inside are very gentle when made without nuts, dried fruit, or spicy sausage.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Stick to classic white/sourdough bread stuffing moistened with bone broth (pick around large celery/onion pieces, and avoid stuffing containing walnuts, pecans, dried cranberries, oysters, or spicy sausage).
watchOuts: Avoid "fancy" stuffings with chopped nuts, dried cranberries/raisins, or spicy Italian sausage
